# ParticleRenderer

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Particles` · record

```csharp
public abstract record ParticleRenderer
```

Draws an effect's particles from their final state. The built-in renderers draw textures ([`Sprite`](#sprite), [`AnyOf`](#anyof)), sprite animations ([`Animation`](#animation)), stretched sprites ([`Stretched`](#stretched)), and several renderers at once ([`Composite`](#composite)); a game adds its own by deriving from this.

## Remarks

A renderer is immutable data, like the rest of an effect, so `with` makes variants and one renderer can be shared by many effects.

A renderer draws into the batch it's given, which the caller has begun: it can't change the transform. Text needs nothing special: `DrawString` draws with the font's own shader, whatever the batch began with.

### AnyOf

```csharp
public static SpriteParticleRenderer AnyOf(params ITextureSource[] textures)
```

Types: [`SpriteParticleRenderer`](SpriteParticleRenderer.md), [`ITextureSource`](ITextureSource.md)

Each particle draws one of `textures`, chosen by its [`Particle.Variant`](Particle.md#variant), so it keeps the same one for its life.

### Composite

```csharp
public static CompositeParticleRenderer Composite(params ParticleRenderer[] renderers)
```

Types: [`CompositeParticleRenderer`](CompositeParticleRenderer.md)

The same particles drawn by each of `renderers` in turn, for example a soft glow under a crisp core.

### Draw

```csharp

```

Types: [`SpriteBatch`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/SpriteBatch.md), [`ParticleDrawState`](ParticleDrawState.md)

Draws an effect's live particles, oldest first, into the caller's batch. Fully transparent particles are left out.

### Stretched

```csharp
public static StretchedSpriteParticleRenderer Stretched(ITextureSource texture, float lengthPerSpeed)
```

Types: [`StretchedSpriteParticleRenderer`](StretchedSpriteParticleRenderer.md), [`ITextureSource`](ITextureSource.md)

Particles draw `texture` pointed along their velocity and lengthened in proportion to their speed, for sparks, rain, and speed lines.

| Parameter | |
|---|---|
| `texture` | The texture, drawn pointing right. |
| `lengthPerSpeed` | How much longer it draws per pixel per second of speed. |
